limits: Same checkpoint/engines, node-local warmed file paths for every mode, current public mono loader, B1 frontend graphs;11alternating repeats. Each sample includes executor creation/join, headers, read/decode/resample and full streaming request. CPU preloading only prepares reference outputs. No cold disk/Lustre/network claim. All session pools resident, not standalone VRAM; future loaded batches bounded by count not bytes. No combined frontend/mono gain claim. Only102M timing measured in this job. Earlier1B replication is separate. Six102M model lifecycles compare every iteration to saved output; per-worker final JSON stores the last completed iteration.

lifetime_interpretation: Frozen pooled frontend aliases a stream used by a subsequently destroyed graph; replay then reports CUDA illegal address. Exclusive native stream has no alias, returns exact features after graph churn, releases finalizer, and passes six102M/three1B API lifecycles. Supports stream-keyed cuBLAS workspace invalidation as the reproduced mechanism. No claim that all asynchronous CUDA errors share this cause.
